div.div: مُغْرق , [as though مُغَرِقٌ, but I think it more probable that it is correctly ↓ مُغَرِّقٌ ,] applied to a she-camel, That casts her young one, in a perfect state or otherwise, and will not be made to incline to it, or to affect it, nor will be milked; not such as yields her milk copiously, nor [such as is termed] خَلِفَة [q. v.]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
